summary: Frontend-only validation of Lyric Themes (P0) + Lyric Card studio styles on Treesh single-file SPA. Covered all 10 scenarios in the review_request end-to-end on desktop (1400x850) AND iPhone 13 viewports via /app/memory/tests/lyt_full.py. 8 themes (classic, chat, neon, type, note, term, comic, pola) each render without horizontal overflow, correctly set treesh_lyt + np-lyrics[data-lyt] + .lyt-on class, support lyric tap-to-seek. Chat theme shows wc-root bubbles with artist avatars, lyt-chat-start header, 'Read 0:40' receipt, typing dots row, and future lines hidden (visible 15/60 at t=40s). Pin logic verified: pinning writes treesh_lyt_song[songId], global treesh_lyt stays unchanged when picking another tile pinned, un-pin removes entry and song follows global. Settings Appearance section + 8 tiles present and clickable (writes treesh_lyt). SETTINGS_INDEX entry 'Lyric theme' indexed. Lyric Card studio Style card lists 8 tiles; picking non-classic sets styleName, hides bg/type/badge cards, redraws 1080x1080 canvas; Classic restores them. Karaoke forces #np-lyric-region[data-lyt=classic]. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors across both runs. Play/pause toggle still works.

test_results.toolbar_button: PASS - lyt-open-button-d visible on desktop, lyt-open-button visible on iPhone 13
test_results.sheet_open_close: PASS - sheet opens with 8 tiles; classic tile labeled 'Default'; closes via lyt-backdrop (count->0) and lyt-close
test_results.8_themes_render: PASS - all 8 themes set data-lyt + treesh_lyt, lyt-on class only for non-classic, no horizontal overflow on either viewport. Chat/Term are progressive (visible 15/60, 18/60 at t=40s).
test_results.chat_theme: PASS - wc-root bubbles=122, avatars=63, lyt-chat-start header, Read 0:40 receipt, future lines hidden, typing-dots row appears
test_results.pin_per_song: PASS - pinning chat writes treesh_lyt_song={song:'chat'}; picking neon with pin on changes pin to 'neon' and global stays 'chat'; un-pin removes entry and cur reverts to global 'chat'
test_results.lyric_seek_all_themes: PASS - tapping [data-act=lyric-seek] in classic/chat/neon/type/note/term/comic/pola jumps audio.currentTime to ~target data-t (all |diff|<1.5s)
test_results.karaoke_forces_classic: PASS - during karaoke #np-lyric-region[data-lyt]='classic' (np-lyrics is replaced by kstage during karaoke, region keeps classic)
test_results.options_menu_lyt: PASS - [data-act=lyrics-tools-menu] contains [data-testid=lyrictool-lyt-open] which opens the same lyt-sheet
test_results.settings_appearance: PASS - [data-testid=settings-lyric-theme] section present with 8 [data-testid=settings-lyt-*] tiles; clicking neon writes treesh_lyt='"neon"'; SETTINGS_INDEX indexed 1 entry labeled 'Lyric theme'
test_results.lyric_card_studio_styles: PASS - [data-testid=lyric-card-style-card] with 8 [data-testid=card-style-*] tiles; non-classic styles update [data-testid=lyric-card-style-name], add 'hidden' to bg/type/badge cards, canvas redrawn at 1080x1080; Classic un-hides them
test_results.page_errors: PASS - zero pageerror and zero console errors on both desktop and mobile runs

critical_code_review_comments: lytApply correctly short-circuits when #np-lyrics is absent (karaoke/edit modes replace that region with kstage); region data-lyt is used as the authoritative classic flag — this works but a comment would help future maintainers.
All 8 lyric themes and 8 card styles are implemented cleanly in p9zp.js + p9zq.js with proper gating of Classic-only studio cards via 'hidden' class.
test_credentials: None (static index.html). Seed localStorage: treesh_whatsnew_off='true', treesh_eco_seen='1', treesh_profile={nickname:'Tester',birthday:'2000-01-01'}.
seed_data_creation: localStorage keys cleared before each run: treesh_lyt, treesh_lyt_song. Song opened via playSong(SONG_BY_ID['chelly-banqz-shake-it-some-mo']) with state.showLyrics=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: lyt_full.py is the canonical regression. Run `python3 /app/memory/tests/lyt_full.py` for desktop and `python3 /app/memory/tests/lyt_full.py m` for iPhone 13. Note: on iPhone 13 the +15 Starlites toast can intercept clicks on the lyt-open-button — all clicks must use force=True. The backdrop testid 'lyt-backdrop' responds to .click() via DOM .click() but not reliably with Playwright's actionability click due to overlay layering; use evaluate b.click(). Karaoke mode replaces #np-lyrics with the kstage so check #np-lyric-region[data-lyt] instead.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all P0 lyric theme + card style scenarios pass
